title: .NET Developer
description:
Hi, I'm Yovko. I'm a .NET developer with around four years of professional experience, mainly focused on backend development with C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, and SQL.
In my current work, I maintain and improve existing production systems, work with APIs, databases, background services, messaging, and CI/CD pipelines. 
Outside my main work, I build my own .NET applications where I focus on clean architecture, automated testing, background processing, database design, and AI integrations.
I'm particularly interested in backend engineering and building systems that are reliable, maintainable, and easy to extend. 
I've also worked on modernizing build and deployment processes, including migrating a large Jenkins pipeline to GitHub Actions.
name: Yovko Garkov
